projectDescription: A mobile marketplace app for students at Universidad Católica Sedes Sapientiae (UCSS) to buy and sell textbooks, supplies, clothing, technology, and services with secure on-campus delivery.
keyFeatures: Product catalog with category filtering and search for textbooks, supplies, technology, uniforms, food, and tutoring services
In-app checkout with quantity selection and campus delivery point selection
Payment via Yape, Plin, and cash on delivery with voucher upload
Order management dashboard with separate buyer (Mis Compras) and seller (Mis Ventas) views
Seller tools: create listings with photos (camera or gallery), title, description, price, stock, and academic category
Payment review workflow: sellers can approve or reject payment vouchers submitted by buyers
On-campus secure delivery spots (cafetería, biblioteca, pabellón B)
PDF order receipt generation and download
Favorites list for saving products of interest
Dark and light mode support with UCSS institutional navy and gold branding
publicApiSurface: create_market_order (Supabase RPC) — creates an order with pessimistic stock lock
process_order_payment (Supabase RPC) — registers a payment with voucher URL
StorageService.uploadVoucherImage — uploads payment voucher to Supabase Storage
StorageService (product images) — uploads product photos to Supabase Storage
Order statuses: pendiente_pago, pago_en_revision, pagado, entregado, cancelado
Payment methods: yape, plin, efectivo, transferencia
Product statuses: disponible, agotado, pausado, eliminado
